title: bn254-pairing-inversion: Self-Contained Pure-Scalar C6-m184_w216-rec (6,2) STNFS (de Bruijn + 4-Cap Z[omega] LA): 2^87.543968200

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the self-contained 100% pure-scalar AArch64 algorithm of proof.md (C6-m184_w216-rec content-reduced reciprocal CM-sextic tower, order-6 Frobenius tau = Frob^10, Arch B-Hybrid reversed a-table replay with pure-scalar 64-bit SWAR scan+zero and analytical Gaussian-volume-ratio Band-3 7D Fincke-Pohst coset enumeration over [2^53.5, 2^58.0), live norm-histogram-weighted full de Bruijn rho_dB and Stage B, B_f = 2^60, B_g = 2^59, excess 0.95, full un-discounted Schirokauer maps, 1-owner 3-bucket Z[omega] Block Wiedemann with deterministic pre-merge weight guard W_avg <= 201.0 and 4-parameter hard-cap abort/pricing at (N_sw_cap = 0.00310*U', N_l_cap = 0.00175*U', k5_cap = 11.50, tab_r_cap = 0.85, lazy=0), and live 62-row 12D descent at B_g = 2^59 using pure QBINS/BOOT_BINS and min_k(P(M < k) + psi^k) with explicit conditional hazard) returns (P0, [x]Q0) with e(P0, [x]Q0) = z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64) * 2^88.895144202 <= 2^87.543968200 units (C = 20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under declared exploratory heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, and H-SEP (proof.md Section 6, explicitly including H3 that production filtered outputs satisfy all four hard caps with abort <= 0.001000, and H5's pure QBINS/BOOT_BINS norm envelope, overdispersed count tail P(M < k), explicit conditional failure hazard <= psi, and history-conditional orbit collision hazard <= 4.0/(li(2^59)/6)). A run gate opens the run only when a fresh 64-bit coin is below K = 7230614641623373948, the least integer with (K/2^64) * 0.994968 >= 0.39; a closed run fails at cost 1 unit. Opened-run success >= 0.994968 is bounded by a strict additive union bound (FIX-U). Neither finite-scale simulator outcomes nor sample confidence intervals are substituted for the attack's production success probability. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification, and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized.
